scope: All 113 caption keys in each of the seven locales were read against the revised Japanese/English sources. The other 72 source keys are unchanged in this source revision.
display_boundary: Each literal newline is an author-reviewed display boundary. Natural font wrapping stays inside that unit. No width/word/line-count page cuts are authored.
sentence_policy: Every unit is a complete concise sentence or complete instruction. Contrastive clauses within a sentence preserve a single comparison, such as cell capacity versus provider throughput.
continuation_rationale: No clause-continuation exception was needed for these revised locale captions at the intended 180 px authoring width; measured-font validation remains the primary agent responsibility.

terminology.proposed_labels: For untranslated release keys, existing English identities are retained or restored at first caption use and the concise local proposal is explicitly marked (अस्थायी, 暫譯, dịch tạm, sementara). These are guide proposals, not claims of official upstream localization.

verification_limits: This record is authoring/semantic review, JSON coverage, terminal punctuation and preservation evidence. It does not claim actual font, GUI, Minecraft playback or Prism simultaneous-instance testing.

font_authoring_revision.action: Revised the 21 affected caption keys into shorter complete sentences. Where English names plus proposed labels overloaded an action sentence, identify the proposed name in its own complete sentence, followed by the complete role or instruction. No clause-continuation exception or font-based cut was used. Retained ore quantities, chemical identities, operating conditions, ordered checks and alternative tank extraction methods.
font_authoring_revision.status: Authoring corrections complete; actual-font rerun pending. This does not claim the 23 units now pass real-font validation.
